reviews.title: Highly intrusive service
reviews.text:
I don't share the enthusiastic reviews for this app. The way it structures items for cleaning is very bizarre. But that’s not even the main issue.
If you ever decide to cancel your subscription, doing so is no easy task. The app will try to charge your card by any means necessary. Even though I cancelled my subscription well in advance, it still tried to pull money. Luckily, I didn't have enough funds left in my account for subscriptions. They simply ran out.
Perhaps the developer can explain to me why, despite cancelling my subscription in my account beforehand, I am still seeing attempted charges?
This is a violation of my consumer rights

reviews.title: Keeps crashing
reviews.text: This is by far the worst app I’ve ever used in my life. I’m brand new to iPhone and needed to cleanup approx 500GB worth of my storage and every time I open this app by the time it’s about to get done scanning so I can start selecting stuff to delete the app crashes then when it opens again it’s gotta start all over. It takes 35 min by the time it crashes this is ridiculous. Honestly I’m glad I didn’t have to pay for this app first because $10/wk by far this app isn’t worth the time it has taken just to keep scanning. I downloaded this app approx 2pm EST it’s now 530pm and I’m still stuck with a full storage. All I want to do is delete the stuff that’s backed up to my iCloud account so I don’t lose the images videos and documents. So they’ll be off my phone but still be in my cloud storage. One thing about the Galaxy all you got to do is backup to Google and click the button to automatically delete which folders you want removed from your phone all with one click. This by far is the worse app I’ve ever seen in my life. I just posted all of this on my fb page to my 4,998 friends and I posted it on my IG where I have 50k followers bcuz you people should’ve made a better app. Honestly it’s so horrible even to be 100% free it’s not WORTH THE HASSLE!!!!!!!!!!!
